sources.entry: jetlog - Personal flight tracker and viewer. GPL-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Jetlog is a self-hostable personal flight tracker and viewer for logging and mapping your past flights.
summary.what_it_does: Jetlog lets you record past flights and view them on a world map. It provides statistics across all your flights and supports adding, editing, and deleting entries. It has a responsive web interface and supports multiple user accounts with authentication. Data can be imported from MyFlightRadar24 or custom CSV files, and exported to CSV or iCal. Automatic flight fetching by flight number uses the external adsbdb API, which can be disabled with an environment variable.
use_cases: view flights on a world map
export flight log to CSV or iCal
share a flight tracker with multiple users on a home server
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml using the image pbogre/jetlog:latest with a volume mapped to /data
Set the SECRET_KEY environment variable to a long random string
Log in with the default admin/admin account and change the password immediately
See the installation wiki for troubleshooting, environment variables, and path-prefix setup
notable: World map view of flights using react-simple-map
Import from MyFlightRadar24 and custom CSV, export to CSV and iCal
Optional external API lookup can be turned off via ENABLE_EXTERNAL_APIS=false
caveats: Default admin credentials are admin/admin and must be changed after first login
Automatic flight lookup relies on the external adsbdb API unless disabled
keywords: keep a record of my trips
log my flights on a map
